mutants.name: FreshnessGate out of the default set

section fetch without the trust gate

mutants.name: unchanged check ignores OKF values
mutants.old:
AND d.okf_concept_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM @okfConceptId
              AND d.trust_tier = @okfTrustTier
              AND d.authorship = @okfAuthorship
              AND d.stale_after IS NOT DISTINCT FROM @okfStaleAfter
              AND d.generated_at IS NOT DISTINCT FROM @okfGeneratedAt
              AND d.last_verified_at IS NOT DISTINCT FROM @okfLastVerifiedAt
              AND d.frontmatter_state = @okfFrontmatterState
mutants.new:
AND @okfConceptId IS NOT DISTINCT FROM @okfConceptId
              AND @okfTrustTier = @okfTrustTier
              AND @okfAuthorship = @okfAuthorship
              AND @okfStaleAfter IS NOT DISTINCT FROM @okfStaleAfter
              AND @okfGeneratedAt IS NOT DISTINCT FROM @okfGeneratedAt
              AND @okfLastVerifiedAt IS NOT DISTINCT FROM @okfLastVerifiedAt
              AND @okfFrontmatterState = @okfFrontmatterState
